definitions.gloss: to lose sight of, to lose track of
definitions.explanation: To no longer be able to see someone or something that one was watching or following. Used both literally (losing visual contact) and figuratively (losing one's sense of direction or purpose).

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見失|みうしな}った。
examples.english: I lost sight of the suspect.

examples.japanese: {人混|ひとご}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見失|みうしな}ってしまった。
examples.english: I lost sight of my child in the crowd.

examples.japanese: {忙|いそが}しさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われて→追う：02016_ou⟧、⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やりたい→やる：02980_yaru⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見失|みうしな}って⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Caught up in busyness, I had lost sight of what I really wanted to do.

notes:
USAGE:
{見失|みうしな}う is a compound verb combining ⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧ (see) and ⟦{失|うしな}う→失う：01887_ushinau⟧ (to lose). The figurative use — losing sight of one's goals, purpose, or identity — is very common, especially in expressions like ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見失|みうしな}う (to lose sight of oneself).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見失|みうしな}う: to lose sight of the suspect
- ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見失|みうしな}う: to lose sight of one's goal
- ⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見失|みうしな}う: to lose oneself
- ⟦{方向|ほうこう}→方向：03617_houkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{見失|みうしな}う: to lose one's bearings
